about.title: About
paragraphs: I have spent nearly 5 years running critical production infrastructure: monitoring, L2/L3 incident diagnosis, virtual machine provisioning and Linux and Windows administration. I have worked with French, Canadian and international clients.

I specialise in observability and automation. I build monitoring and dashboards with Zabbix, Grafana and Prometheus, and automate their configuration through GitOps, with GitLab CI/CD and NetBox as the source of truth. With a Master’s in Cybersecurity, I bring security into operations: system hardening, access management and alert monitoring.
I am looking for a role focused on observability and automation, in Morocco, France or remote. Arabic is my native language, and I work in French and English every day.
